aboutUs.heading: Building inclusion through sport since 1983
aboutUs.paragraph: Special Olympics Singapore is part of the world's largest sports movement for people with intellectual disabilities. Guided by a committed Board of Directors, we deliver year-round training and competitions across various Olympic-type sports, expand access to health and fitness, and grow leadership opportunities—so athletes can build fitness, demonstrate courage, experience joy, and be accepted and respected in their communities.

hero.quote: Special Olympics envisions a world where people with intellectual disabilities lead healthy, vibrant lives grounded in ongoing sports and physical activities...

oath.text: Let me win. But if I cannot win, let me be brave in the attempt.
oath.caption: Special Olympics Athlete's Oath

impact.heading: Inclusion at scale—training, health, and leadership across Singapore
impact.paragraph: From local talent hunts to National Games and international stages, we support athletes with intellectual disabilities through year-round coaching, health screenings, family networks, and Unified Sports.

donate.heading: Fuel the Future of Our Athletes
donate.paragraph: Your contribution directly powers year-round sports training, health screenings, and competitions for individuals with intellectual disabilities. Help us build inclusion, confidence, and joy through sport.
